exposure: Placenta previa anterior with at least one previous cesarean section
outcome: Accuracy of Doppler ultrasound in diagnosing PA
cohort: 100 patients with placenta previa (PP) anterior with at least one previous CS
finding: Doppler ultrasound findings, such as loss of retroplacental clear zone, intraplacental lacunae, hypervascularity in the uterine bladder interface, and blood vessels invading the myometrium, were significantly associated with PA and can be used to improve prenatal diagnosis and management.
